sheets.title: A new account's password — 390 wide
sheets.caption: One line, like a website: the password with its keys inside its rule, and the × at the end of the line.
sheets.before: The password under its label, the × beside the label, an Options line beneath
sheets.after: The password, its keys and the × on one line

sheets.title: The generator's options — 390 wide
sheets.caption: They open from a key on the password's line, and close the same way.
sheets.before: An Options disclosure on a line of its own
sheets.after: A key on the password's line opens the same options

sheets.title: An API key and a token added — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Each value on one line: the API header, then its value; the token. The × ends the first line of each.
sheets.before: A block per method, a title row with the ×, fields under it
sheets.after: API header and X-Api-Key value, one line each

sheets.title: The saved account — 390 wide
sheets.caption: The API key reads like a username and password: the header, copyable, and its value, hidden and copyable.
sheets.before: Header (no copy key) and a Header with key line
sheets.after: API header (copy) and X-Api-Key value (reveal, copy)
